item.text: I’ll trace the SSH multiplexer and its existing protocol classification/address handling, write the required checkpoint, then implement the prefixed path and run the relevant existing tests.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -80; git status --short; mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Issue: support Teleport-Proxy-prefixed SSH connections in the SSH multiplexer and expose optional ClientAddr as RemoteAddr.

Progress: repository inspection started. Next: locate multiplexer and related tests, implement parsing/routing/address wrapper, run relevant existing tests.
EOF"
